audit_definition.comparison_rule: for each operator and tolerance use the maximum feasible prefix for native and transported targets
audit_definition.orientation_rule: compare transported/native budget ratios on left and right operators
audit_definition.transport_rule: replace overlap labels by the optimally globally aligned neighboring label; retain native labels off the overlap

exact_theorem.fixed_operator_counterfactual: within each operator row, only the target label vector is changed
exact_theorem.global_sign_invariance: a simultaneous global sign on a complete target leaves its budget unchanged
exact_theorem.scope: finite full-shell target swap with native off-overlap extension; no causal or asymptotic inference
